item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Compute templates for Azure
item.description:
Azure has introduced a limited preview of compute templates, which let customers define, version, and reuse standardized VM configurations across deployments. The feature is aimed at simplifying virtual machine configuration management.

  • Source: Azure Updates
